verdict.rationale: Clerky ships a live MCP server (mcp.clerky.com) enabling Claude/ChatGPT and other AI assistants to invoke Clerky tools with team-scoped access, which is the mechanism for natural-language operation; a probe confirms the endpoint is real and OAuth-gated rather than vaporware. Missing for 10: no hands-on transcript or independent report of actually issuing natural-language commands through the MCP tools, and no evidence of a broader in-app conversational/NL command interface beyond the MCP integration.
